text: Steenbarger: neither as filed. in_zone:ma_20 is not a trading zone on my method; I objected and hold that. But a bare h1_close_above:bar_high at D close_vs_swing_high_pct 8.52, W 20.49 buys a move away from value (C3, C15). R2 joins both: in_zone:structure_shift_ref on D (the test of the broken Creek, C7), then h1_close_above:bar_high there as the sign-of-strength follow-through (C12).
